name: lacrosse-stick
description: A lacrosse stick with a flared mesh head and long straight shaft.
useCase: Identify lacrosse sticks or lacrosse training equipment.
misuse: Use a visible label when equipment identifies a sport, product or activity.

16.reason: A smaller curved head leaves room for a long shaft and one clear opening.

24.reason: The curved scoop narrows to the throat, with one full net strand inside the open head.
